lt_email_change_tokens.subject: request_id -> lt_email_changes.id
lt_email_change_tokens.used: single conditional UPDATE; no login session

lt_email_change_payloads.subject: outbox_id -> lt_outbox.id; token_hash -> lt_email_change_tokens.hash
lt_email_change_payloads.expires: linked token deadline; scrub on consumption/revocation/expiry

lt_email_change_operations.subject: application_id/request_id, verified actor and operation_id
private_fields: payload_hash and subject IDs; no cached DTO
lt_email_change_operations.read_gate: fresh role/parent TTL, current request and current owner; superseded receipt ->409

retention_handler.mode: dry-run only; no production deletion enabled
retention_handler.input: server-selected event IDs with fixed private_expires<=trusted cutoff; exact application/request/source IDs
child_order: lt_mail_jobs for application:<email-change payload outbox IDs>
lt_outbox rows for associated verification/final notifications (shared business-outbox handler)
lt_applications (shared handler after all private children)
retention_handler.guard: recheck exact event cutoff/IDs in transaction, repeat safely; never extend cutoff
retention_handler.auth_boundary: do not purge login token/session by email match; they have independent expiry. Old-address session invalidation occurs only in authorized email confirm transaction
retention_handler.public_archive: normal ended public snapshot/event row retained; cancellation follows existing separate deletion policy
